name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: No unexplained clusters found to 9 Nov; WHO is following one fatal human Shamonda virus infection in France
state: WHO reported on 2 Nov the first laboratory-confirmed human infection with Shamonda virus, a known animal virus, in one patient in eastern France who died on 8 Oct. No further cases had been detected, testing of close contacts continues, and WHO says the risk cannot yet be reliably assessed. UKHSA's monitoring report for the week ending 1 Nov listed no unexplained cluster. A single case of a known virus is not a cluster, so the level stays Normal as of 9 Nov.
for_you: No action is indicated for the public. Travellers can check NaTHNaC's outbreak surveillance pages and WHO Disease Outbreak News for official updates.
rubric_hit: No unexplained clusters under international investigation; Shamonda is one case of a known virus (WHO, 2 Nov): Normal.
